field_definitions.parent_formation_id: Proposed foreign-key to immediate superior formation. Null where unknown/not applicable.
field_definitions.zone_id: Proposed foreign-key to NIS zonal office; state-to-zone mapping should be validated against internal NIS deployment records.
field_definitions.stateid: Proposed stable internal Nigeria state identifier in NG-XX format; not an official NIS code.
field_definitions.LGA: Local Government Area; null where not verified.
field_definitions.formation_code: Proposed human-readable internal code; not an official NIS establishment code.
field_definitions.gps_coordinates: Latitude/longitude; null until verified from official GIS/GPS records.
field_definitions.official_telephone: Official formation contact; null where not published/verified.
field_definitions.official_email: Official formation email; null where not published/verified.
field_definitions.commanding_officer: Current officer in charge; intentionally null unless publicly verified.
field_definitions.establishment_date: Date formation was established; intentionally null unless publicly verified.
field_definitions.formation_grade: NIS establishment/rank grade; null unless officially documented.
field_definitions.staffing_strength: Approved or actual staffing establishment; null unless supplied by NIS.
field_definitions.facilities: Operational facility categories; these are schema descriptors and should be verified as physical assets.
field_definitions.last_verified_date: Date the record was last verified against an authoritative source.

data_quality_rules: Do not infer commanding officers, staffing strength, establishment dates, GPS coordinates or formation grades from assumptions.
Do not treat proposed state-to-zone relationships as official until checked against the current NIS establishment/deployment register.
Use null for unpublished or unverified contact and location fields.
Maintain last_verified_date whenever a formation is verified.
Historical counts from the 2019-2023 Border Management Strategy must not be interpreted as current 2026 counts.
source_register_note: Current NIS public sources establish the organizational hierarchy and HQ contact information; detailed formation-level operational fields require NIS internal verification.
